title: gicg eval_service request schema
description: JSON request body for the localhost TCP eval_service. Authoritative — server validates against this and clients generate CLI / help from this. Add a new request kind by extending the top-level `oneOf`; add a new player type by extending `$defs.player_spec.oneOf`.

player_spec_az_or_cfr.description: AZ or CFR player — uses a trained network; ckpt required.

n_simulations.description: MCTS rollouts. 0 = argmax over the policy head, no search.

player_spec_random.description: Random player — uniform over legal actions.

player_spec_mcts_pure.description: Pure IS-MCTS player — no network, uniform prior.

n_simulations.description: MCTS rollouts. Must be >= 1 (no network prior to fall back on).

player_spec_greedy.description: Feature-based greedy evaluation opponent; no network.

features.description: Feature set for scoring a post-action state. F1 = asymmetric HP delta; F2 adds flat kill/death bonus; F3 adds heal asymmetry; F4 adds shield + reaction asymmetry; F5 adds energy-overflow + piecewise AP-waste + escalating kill slope. F3-F5 read the engine RewardEvents accumulator.

depth.description: Lookahead plies. D1 = NPC (no opponent model); D2 = adversarial 2-ply minimax; D3 = self-3-ply.

dice_greedy.description: Collapse engine payment fan-out via hand-crafted dice-value heuristic (active-color > backline-color > omni > abundant-junk > rare-junk; min total value wins). Reduces per-decision legal-action count from n to n_logical for a 5-30x wall-time speedup. Off by default for back-compat with existing gauntlet results.

player_spec.description: One player spec. `type` discriminates the variant.

oneOf.title: gauntlet
oneOf.description: Run a matchup between two players; record result as a JSONL entry.

id.description: Optional human identifier; server assigns 'g<marker:05d>' if absent.

game_marker.description: Used in default `id` and seed derivation.

players.description: players[0] is the challenger (win-rate reported from its perspective).

deck_padding.description: ADR-0011 deck padding spec, e.g. {"card": "碌碌无为", "target_size": 15}. Null = no padding (deck length = eligible-card count).

pool.description: ADR-0011 pool ID(s) under data/pools/. Null = engine default (["v_legacy"]). Single str or list[str] for sibling-pool union.

deck_0.description: F4 explicit P0 deck — card-name multiset, every name declared in card_pool/pool. Requires mode=fixed. Null = implicit eligible-set path (engine errors if that exceeds deck_padding.target_size).

deck_1.description: F4 explicit P1 deck — same semantics as deck_0.

swap_sides.description: Alternate team-to-side assignment. Set false for CFR ckpts trained with pinned sides.

result_path.description: JSONL file to append the result to.
